description:
• Provides overall direction, guidance, definition and facilitation for the advancement of dashboard development effort to meet business strategies and goals. 
 • Must be able to work independently with different databases (Oracle, MS SQL Server), and analytical/reporting tools such as Cognos, SAS & QlikView. 
 • Understand business requirements very clearly then translate and use complex data sources that needs to be blended and joined to delivery efficient and quality dashboards 
 • Involved in all aspects of the dashboard development life cycle, from the initial kickoff through the requirements analysis, design and implementation. 
 • Follow industry standard techniques and efficient approaches to connect Tableau with disparate data sources. 
 • Mentor internal development team and promote self-service analytics to Medicaid users. 
 • Perform Tableau Test site admin tasks, responsible for production coordination, dashboard deployment, user management and support. 
 • Conduct demo to internal and external Medicaid stake holders. 
 • Develop various dashboard development standards, guidance and create artifacts. 
 • Delivery high quality dashboards adhering to latest trends and complete project on time and work on fast paced development cycle. 

 • At least 2+ years of Tableau development lead experience 
 • At least 2+ years of experience using databases such as Oracle, MS SQL Server 
 • Strong SQL development experience 
 • Required experience in prototyping, designing dashboard mockups and presentations to customers, development artifacts, standards and guidelines 
 • Able to define, document and articulate dashboard processes and governance 
 • Work on complex datasets and data analysis & data preparation tasks 
 • Ability to develop reports & dashboards in QlikView or SAS visualization tools 
 • Experience working with source control (such as TFS). 
 
 
 DESIRED Skill Sets : 2+ years of experience working with R, SSIS and SSAS 

 
 Highlights and benefits 
 
 We are a registered E verified company 
 Starting salary between $ 60,000 with regular increments 
 Free classroom skill enhancement program 
 Relocation allowance 
 Referral bonus 
 On the job support from experienced professionals in the relative field 
 Travel allowance 
 Insurance- Medical, dental, vision and 401K 
 Health Benefits through Carefirst BCBS (Blue Cross Blue Shield) 
 Company paid Life Insurance 
 
 Please respond with your resume. US Citizens and all other parties authorized to work in the US are encouraged to apply. 
 

 Job Type: W2/Contract
 Salary: $60,000.00 /year
 Required education:
 Bachelor's
 Required experience:
 Developer: 5-12year
